description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Central Bank  Balance sheet as at 31st January, 2017
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's balance sheet and financial statements as of January 31, 2017, including assets, liabilities, and financial instruments. This constitutes banking and financial institution regulatory reporting, which falls under commercial matters (business and financial institution regulations). The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories, making Commercial (Type 6) the appropriate classification.
